title: Why AI Jailbreaks Still Work in 2026 (ICML Demo)
description:
Researchers at ICML 2026 showed why jailbreaks still work 🔥

The model can't see where dev instructions end and your request begins. Its all just text to it, and it guesses the role from writting style alone. So a crafted prompt can talk it out of it's own rules 😅

If you build agents: treat guardrails as a hint, not a wall. Check every critical action outside the model ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
